summary.text: Kerala defeated ODSA by an innings and 36 runs after posting 404 all out in their first innings, led by Mohammed Azharuddeen with 139 runs off 263 balls. ODSA was bowled out for 225 and 143 following-on, with Gourav Choudhary scoring 50 off 96 balls and 53 off 111 balls respectively. Kerala bowlers Lalit M Yadav, Vaisakh Chandran, and Jalaj Saxena claimed best bowling figures of 3 for 53, 4 for 40, and 5 for 34 in their respective spells.
